strengths: Very fast, follows the step/citation format, gets exact numbers right on most dosing cases (bleach, ORS, boiling), handles French/Spanish and gives clean refusals on idk cases while ignoring the injection.
weaknesses: Frequently adds outside knowledge with fabricated [S#] citations, including a dangerous reversal on snake bite (ice, tourniquet); it misuses 'I don't know', misreads trust labels and seldom flags Community sources or uncovered parts correctly.
